title: kate-core: match an indenter name in either case
summary: newline_for_indenter treats Python and CStyle like python and cstyle. Other names stay plain. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. The newline command stays on newline_insertion.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Compare the indenter name with ASCII case folding. Python and PYTHON call python_newline. CStyle and CSTYLE call newline_insertion with cstyle true. None and other names stay plain. The existing python and cstyle tests stay green. Leave workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0093 is on main. workspace.rs is free. This wave still leaves workspace.rs, keys.rs, and repository.rs unchanged. PKT-0100 owns repository.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: indent::tests::indenter_names_match_in_either_case
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. For def f(): at the end of the line, Python returns only a newline today. After the change it returns a newline plus four spaces. CStyle on four spaces, foo, brace returns a newline plus eight spaces.
